chapter: Faith, Paris life and later years
title: Why he likes living in France: choosing whom to say bonjour to
summary: He values the French way of life where you need not greet everyone and are respected.

blocks.x: Because I mean this is the -- this is the living that you love.
That I love, yeah. Yeah. Well, people --
It's free living, according to your instinct, and your --
I mean it's the idea you can go about your business and you don't have to say bonjour to anyone.
And the minute you say bonjour, you strike up a friendship.
So you pick the people you want to say bonjour to. You don't have to --
That's right. You don't have to say bonjour to everyone.
I pick the people in the village where I live, and certain people I say bonjour, and certain people I don't say anything to.
: So that keeps the drags in their place.
That's right. And everyone accepts it because that's the way they live.
